title: How to Win with AI in 2026 🤯
description:
2026 belongs to people who know how to use AI effectively.

The biggest mistake you can make is spending all your time collecting AI tools instead of building real skills.

In this video, I’ll show you the framework to stay ahead:

• Learn AI fundamentals
• Build systems instead of doing everything manually
• Create content at scale
• Learn AI automation
• Build products with vibe coding
• Use AI for research, marketing, and execution
• Focus on outcomes, not tools

The winners in 2026 won’t be the people with the most AI tools.

They’ll be the people who know how to combine AI, distribution, sales, and execution.

Formula:

AI + Distribution + Sales + Execution = Massive Advantage

The future is already here. The question is whether you’re adapting fast enough.

Follow me on Instagram: @aiwithratul
